title: Exact derived exchange commutes with a filtered colimit of sheaves
statement: Let e:Y to T, h:Y to X, g:T to S, p:X to S form a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with g quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let J be a small filtered category and M:J to Ab(T_et) a diagram [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. If the canonical exact derived exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] on M(j)[0] is invertible for every j, then its component on (colim M)[0] is invertible.

source.place: Tag 0F1I, lemma-punctual-base-change, degree-zero and bounded-exponent reductions; Tag 073E, filtered colimits

proof.text: The base change h of g is qcqs. In each integer degree, exact inverse image and the single-complex comparisons identify the source functor with higher direct image followed by inverse image and the target functor with inverse image followed by higher direct image. Bounded-below/unbounded compatibility identifies these higher direct images.

Both endpoint functors preserve filtered colimits by abelian higher direct-image preservation and inverse-image colimit preservation. Apply Mathlib isIso_app_coconePt_of_preservesColimit to the homology of the natural exchange transformation. Its diagram components are invertible; hence so is its component at the colimit. Cohomology detects invertibility of the derived morphism.

theorem isIso_exactExchange_colimit
    {X S T Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ S} {g : T ⟶ S}
    {e : Y ⟶ T} {h : Y ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback e h g p)
    [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (J : Type) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (M : J ⥤ Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hM : ∀ j, IsIso ((exactDerivedBaseChangeMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      sq.toCommSq).app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (M.obj j)))) :
    IsIso ((exactDerivedBaseChangeMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq.toCommSq).app
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (colimit M)))
